title: Modal verbs + have + past participle · 情态动词的过去形式
pattern: should / could / might / must / can't / needn't + have + past participle
summary: 情态动词加 have + 过去分词，用来评价过去的事：后悔、可惜、推测或“其实没必要”。
explanation: **情态动词 + have + 过去分词** 用来谈论过去。它不表示“过去做了”，而是表示说话人对过去事情的态度或判断。例如 You **should have told** me.（你本该告诉我。）说的是没有做到的事，带有批评或遗憾的意味。
**should have / could have** 用来表达“本来应该 / 本来可以，但实际没有做”：I **could have taken** the earlier train.（我本来可以坐早一班的火车。）should have 带有后悔或责备，could have 则只是说“当时有这个可能”。

**might have / must have / can't have** 用来对过去的情况做推测。might have 表示“也许……”（He **might have forgotten** the meeting.）；must have 表示“一定……”（She **must have been** very tired.）；can't have 表示“不可能……”（They **can't have finished** so quickly.）。注意：表示肯定推测用 must have，can 只用于否定句和疑问句。
**needn't have + 过去分词** 表示“本来没必要做，却做了”：You **needn't have bought** such an expensive gift.（你没必要买这么贵的礼物。）对比 didn't need to buy，后者表示“没有去买”，前者则表示“买了，但没必要”，中文都可能译成“没必要”，所以要特别留意。
中文的“应该、可能、一定”没有时态区分，学习者常常直接把 should、might、must 后面接一般过去时。实际上，只要说的是过去的事，就要在情态动词后面加 have + 过去分词，这一点不能省略。
mistakes: ✗ You should have went there. → ✓ You should have gone there. have 后面必须接过去分词 gone，不能用过去式 went。
✗ He might to have forgotten. → ✓ He might have forgotten. 情态动词后面不加 to，直接接 have + 过去分词。
✗ You needn't bought the tickets. → ✓ You needn't have bought the tickets. 表示“本没必要做却做了”，要用 needn't have + 过去分词。
✗ She can have been at home when I called. → ✓ She must have been at home when I called. 肯定的推测用 must have，can 通常只用于否定句或疑问句。

examples.text: You should have told me earlier.
I should have listened to your advice.
examples.translation: 我当初应该听你的建议。

examples.text: We could have taken the earlier train, but we decided to walk.
examples.translation: 我们本来可以坐早一班火车，但我们决定走路。

examples.text: He might have forgotten the appointment.
She must have been very tired after the long flight.
examples.translation: 长途飞行后她一定很累。

examples.text: They can't have finished the project so quickly.
examples.translation: 他们不可能这么快就完成了项目。
examples.note: can't have 表示对过去的否定推测。

examples.text: You needn't have bought such an expensive gift.
examples.translation: 你没必要买这么贵的礼物。
examples.note: 礼物已经买了，但并不需要。

exercises.sentence: The lights were off when I arrived, so they ___ home by then.
exercises.translation: 我到的时候灯是关着的，所以那时他们一定已经回家了。
options: should have went
have must gone
must have gone
must gone
exercises.explanation: 对过去情况的肯定推测用 must have + 过去分词 gone。

exercises.sentence: I ___ the train, but I decided to take the bus instead.
exercises.translation: 我本来可以坐火车，但我还是决定坐公交车。
options: should have to take
could have taken
could took
must taken
exercises.explanation: 表示过去本来有可能做到却没做，用 could have taken。

exercises.sentence: You ___ so much money on this camera. It was cheap!
exercises.translation: 你没必要在这台相机上花这么多钱，它很便宜！
options: needn't spent
needn't have spent
mustn't spent
needn't to spend
exercises.explanation: 表示“本没必要却花了”，用 needn't have spent。

exercises.source: 他可能没听到你的电话。
options: He might not have heard your call.
He might not to hear your call.
He must not have heard your call.
He might not heard your call.
exercises.explanation: “可能没有……”用 might not have + 过去分词；must not 表示“一定没有”，语气不同。

exercises.source: 他一定很累，因为他一整天都在工作。
options: He might be very tired because he is working all day.
He can have been very tired because he had been working all day.
He must have been very tired because he had been working all day.
He should have been very tired because he had been working all day.
exercises.explanation: 对过去的肯定推测用 must have been；should have been 表示“本该如此”，意思不同。

exercises.source: 你本该早点告诉我这件事。
options: You should have telling me about this earlier.
You should have told me about this earlier.
You should tell me about this earlier.
You must have told me about this earlier.
exercises.explanation: “本该做却没做”用 should have + 过去分词 told。

options: She must have been at the meeting yesterday.
He must have knew the answer.
They might have missed the last train.
exercises.explanation: have 后面要接过去分词 known，应写成 He must have known the answer。

options: You needn't bought a ticket, because it was free.
You needn't have bought a ticket, because it was free.
You didn't need to buy a ticket, because it was free.
exercises.explanation: needn't 后面要用 have + 过去分词，应写成 You needn't have bought a ticket。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.explanation: should have + 过去分词 asked，表示过去本该做却没做。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 他们一定是因为出门太晚而错过了公交车。
exercises.explanation: must have missed 表示对过去的肯定推测，because 引出原因。
